probe_plans.approach: Download XBRL US-GAAP taxonomy zip; extract schema locally; construct XbrlDocument(path) where schema files are on disk with no network hrefs
probe_plans.probe_code_sketch: var xbrl = new XbrlDocument(); var inst = xbrl.XbrlInstances.Add(); inst.SchemaRefs.Add(localSchemaPath, 'xbrl', 'http://xbrl.us/gaap'); inst.Save(outPath, SaveOptions.OFX);
probe_plans.expected_outcome: PASS if local taxonomy is accepted
probe_plans.fallback: Programmatic XBRL construction without loading schema: use XbrlItem/XbrlContext/Unit directly

probe_plans.approach: Extend W17 threed proof: scene.Save(path, new GltfSaveOptions { EnableQuantization = true }) to compress into GLTF 2.0
probe_plans.probe_code_sketch: var scene = new Scene(); scene.RootNode.CreateChildNode(new Box()); var opts = new GltfSaveOptions(); opts.EnableQuantization = true; scene.Save('output/compressed.glb', opts);
probe_plans.expected_outcome: PASS — same Scene API, different save options

probe_plans.approach: Font.Open(TTF) + cast to TtfFont + GetGlyphsForText() + GlyphOutlinePainter; output SVG path data to file
probe_plans.probe_code_sketch: var ttf = Font.Open(fontDef) as TtfFont; var glyphs = ttf.GetGlyphsForText('A'); var painter = new GlyphOutlinePainter(); ttf.DrawGlyph(glyphs[0], painter); File.WriteAllText('output/glyph-path.svg', painter.ToSvg());
probe_plans.expected_outcome: PASS if TtfFont cast works; GlyphOutlinePainter requires System.Drawing

probe_plans.approach: Load two SVGDocuments; use doc1.ImportNode(doc2.RootElement, deep=true); append to doc1; Save merged doc
probe_plans.probe_code_sketch: var doc1 = new SVGDocument(svg1Path); var doc2 = new SVGDocument(svg2Path); var imported = doc1.ImportNode(doc2.RootElement, true); doc1.RootElement.AppendChild(imported); doc1.Save(outPath);
probe_plans.expected_outcome: PASS — SVGDocument.ImportNode is standard DOM API available in Aspose.SVG
